name: Imperial Court
description: The Imperial Court consists of the members of the Imperial Family and accompanying Kuge, or noble families. They preserve the inviolability of the Emperor and ensure the succession.

name: Shogunate Court
description: The powerful samurai clan members surrounding the Shōgun will be advisors in all matters, but without ever completely abandoning their own interests.

name: Ikkō-ikki
description: The fanatic followers of $SECT_JOUDO_SHINSHUU$ from the $SECT_PURE_LAND_SCHOOL_NAME$ of $buddhist$ have organized themselves in different leagues called $ikko_ikki$ and, although mainly composed of peasants, their constant demands and uprisings are starting to be more than a nuisance.

name: Religious Sects
description: There have always been different paths to follow the Buddha, and even within the Kami there are variations in their stories. Each sect will always try to convince others to follow their way, but all of them may prove beneficial.

name: Kirishitan Monks
description: Ever since the westerners arrived to our shores, they have brought their foreign religion with them, with this new Buddha they call Jesus. As long as we want to interact with them, we must allow their beliefs, but that could also be in itself a benefit to us.
